input_fields.name: observation
input_fields.description: One caller-provided measured property record from a native_reopen observation.

input_fields.name: expected_value
input_fields.description: One expected scalar, text, boolean, or flat numeric vector.

input_fields.name: expected_artifact_sha256
input_fields.description: Expected hash of the reopened native artifact.

input_fields.name: absolute_tolerance
input_fields.description: Finite nonnegative tolerance; default may be zero.

result_fields.name: artifact_sha256
result_fields.description: Reopened artifact hash used for binding.

result_fields.name: runtime_observed
result_fields.description: Always false; host helper does not observe SpaceClaim.

procedure: Validate one native_reopen observation and compare its artifact hash with expected_artifact_sha256.
Compare the one property using finite scalar, text/boolean, or flat-vector semantics and absolute_tolerance.
Return the flat host result with actual/expected values and runtime_observed=false.
Do not open SpaceClaim, obtain another measurement, or compare a second property.
rejection_rules: Reject wrong source_kind/action_id, unmeasured observation, missing identity/ref, hash mismatch, unsupported value shape, or negative/nonfinite tolerance.
Do not infer native reopen from a filename.
Do not report runtime observation as passed.
